title: French studios Spiders, Kylotonn, and Cyanide file for insolvency following Nacon bankruptcy
content: Three French game studios — Spiders (GreedFall), Kylotonn (WRC series), and Cyanide (Pro Cycling Manager) — have filed for insolvency. All three are owned by publisher Nacon, which filed for insolvency earlier in 2026 after missing a loan repayment. The filings put hundreds of development jobs at risk across the French games industry.
